name: Nowa
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as the main protagonist.

name: Seign
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after the battle for Hishahn Front when he breaks away from the Imperial army.

name: Melridge
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after the battle for Hishahn Front as the Alliance's tactician.

name: Garr
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game alongside Lian and Mio.

name: Lian
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as part of Nowa's initial squad.

name: Mio
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the start of the game as part of Nowa's initial squad.

name: Perrielle
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the main story events in Euchrisse (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Hildi
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Rody
howToRecruit: Speak to him in the center of Dabavin; select 'Can I talk you into joining us?' and bring him a Pearl Pocketwatch (found in Seaside Cavern).

name: Maxim
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.

name: Mellore
howToRecruit: Speak with her in Eltisweiss during 'The Watch Captain's First Job', then track her to Redthroat Ridge and defeat the Nerthus boss.

name: Yuferius
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after competing in the sandcraft race during 'Shi'arcs of a Scale'.

name: Iris
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' story scene to manage castle drafting and blueprints.

name: Gocteau
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' story scene to manage guild dispatch missions.

name: Marisa
howToRecruit: Playable earlier in the campaign, but officially joins the Alliance roster during the journey to Norristar.

name: Dr. Corque
howToRecruit: Talk to him in Eltisweiss to begin the Beigoma storyline, then defeat Reid in a Beigoma top battle to recruit him (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Huang
howToRecruit: Speak to him in Arenside to obtain the Bamboo Rod, then catch a Wheel-Eye Bream and deliver it to him at the southwest docks in Hishahn.

name: Wayve
howToRecruit: Joins automatically as the Guardians' liaison during the 'A Secret Plan' story conference.

name: Markus
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during 'The Next Steps' story quest when assisting him in investigating his ancestral castle.

name: Hakugin
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the east side of Daphan Village with Mio in your active battle party, and accept her request to join.

name: Ivy
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at the conclusion of Seign's infiltration of the imperial Rune-Lens Research Laboratory (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Yusuke
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the entrance gate of Fort Xialuke during or after 'The Watch Captain's First Job' and recruit him directly.

name: Yume
howToRecruit: Talk to the worried grandmother in Werne, then travel to Redthroat Ridge to find Yume and Friend, and escort them back.

name: Maureus
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the Mountain Path with a character in your party whose MP is 300 or higher (e.g. Francesca, Mellore, or Momo).

name: Yaelu
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Ivy at the end of Seign's mission in the Rune-Lens Research Laboratory (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Reyna
howToRecruit: Speak to her at Dabavin harbor and accept her challenge to deal at least 1,500 total damage to her within 3 turns.

name: Barnard
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the battle for Hishahn Front alongside Melridge and Seign.

name: Gigina
howToRecruit: Talk to this beastfolk fighter across the wooden bridge in southeast Arenside and invite him to join.

name: Wyler
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the entrance of Bounty Hill and agree to help search for his sister Marin, then find her deeper in the hills.

name: Marin
howToRecruit: Recruited alongside her brother Wyler in Bounty Hill after finding her west of the silver chest (usable in Battle or Support).

name: Pieter
howToRecruit: Speak to him tending vegetables in the northwest farm of Werne and answer his questions positively about food and farming.

name: Squash
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the Trading Post in Treefolk Village; bring him a Sparklegem (dropped by Phantombird enemies in the Greatwood).

name: Ormond
howToRecruit: Speak to him in the Abandoned Mine accessible from the castle basement well, and deliver 3 Iron Ore to him.

name: Kerrin
howToRecruit: Speak to her inside the Dappled Forest outside your castle headquarters and deliver 20 Lumber to her.

name: Douglas
howToRecruit: Talk to him inside the Eltisweiss smithy during or after 'New Forces' and deliver 10 Iron Ore to him.

name: Syd
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3, speak to him on the east docks in Hishahn, and bring him 1 Iron Ore, 1 Mystic Lumber, and 1 Dire Beastbone.

name: Kurtz
howToRecruit: Speak to him outside the Hishahn smithy; deliver the Grilled Tutuva recipe (obtained from an NPC in Treefolk Village).

name: Code L
howToRecruit: Talk to him in the Daphan Village rune shop and bring him a Rune of Currents (obtained by defeating the dragon boss in the Old Keep).

name: Hogan
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the pier in Twinhorne West after generating a cumulative trade profit of 50,000 Baqua across regional trading posts.

name: Cassandra
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to establish the headquarters Inn.

name: Carrie
howToRecruit: Encounter her clumsy teleportation attempts around Hishahn multiple times (near palace and bridge) until she formally joins.

name: Stadler
howToRecruit: Speak to him in yellow attire on the beach in Impershi'arc and defeat his military squadron in a mock war battle.

name: Nell
howToRecruit: Inspect the suspiciously moving large sack behind a market stall in northeast Hishahn to discover and recruit him.

name: Paquia
howToRecruit: Speak to her at the foot of the stairs in Arenside and bring her 5 Eggfoot Eggs (dropped by Eggfoot enemies).

name: Frida
howToRecruit: Visit Werne once fast travel is unlocked, speak to her at the armor stall to the left of the entrance, and let her inspect Nowa's styling.

name: Quinn
howToRecruit: Speak to her in Impershi'arc after the sandcraft race, then help her explore the ancient ruins in the Great Sandy Sea.

name: Goldsmid
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the second tier of Yarnaan with a hero whose physical strength stat is over 300 (or select the stalwart warrior dialogue).

name: Kuroto
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the west side of Altverden during or after 'The Watch Captain's First Job', then defeat 3 Wild Boars on the world map.

name: Clarke
howToRecruit: Speak to him near the fountain in Ardinale, purchase the 'Star-Cross'd Lovers' play script from the Ardinale general store, and deliver it.

name: Mariette
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the bench in Twinhorne East; retrieve her lost keepsake charm from Greatwood South (dropped by Rabbit Archwitches).

name: Ymir
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to serve as chief castle administrator.

name: Selbineth
howToRecruit: Build the Mysterious Room in the castle basement (requires HQ Level 3), enter through the red portal, and complete her combat trial.

name: Leon
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 2; find him collapsed near the western exit of Castle Town, give him food and water, and bring him a Rune of Currents.

name: Aoi
howToRecruit: After completing the Athrabalt Summit, speak to her at the lower level of Twinhorne East with Iugo in your party, and defeat her in a duel.

name: Riufan
howToRecruit: Speak to him by the water wheel on the west dock in Hishahn and defeat him in a one-on-one duel with Nowa.

name: B'baba
howToRecruit: Visit the northwest house in Daphan Village during or after 'New Forces' and invite the fortune teller to HQ.

name: Faye
howToRecruit: Recruit B'baba first, consult B'baba in HQ to locate Faye, then play hide-and-seek around Castle Town to catch her.

name: Lam
howToRecruit: Recruit Riufan first, place Riufan in your active party, speak to Lam in Daphan Village, then deliver a Dragon Gem Herb from the Mountain Path.

name: Valentin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Foxiel
howToRecruit: Speak to her at an east market stall in Athrabalt; consult chef Kurtz at HQ to prepare the requested soup and deliver it to her.

name: Iugo
howToRecruit: Enter the tavern in eastern Eltisweiss during 'The Watch Captain's First Job' and speak with him to recruit him.

name: Aire
howToRecruit: Talk to her on the path to the southwest exit in Hishahn and win a footrace against her (requires Nowa at level 36+ or high agility).

name: Rohan
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3 and complete the Athrabalt Front, then speak to him inside the Twinhorne West Inn.

name: Glen
howToRecruit: Return to Arenside once fast travel is unlocked, talk to him outside the western residence, and defeat a challenger in Card Battle.

name: Lakian
howToRecruit: Joins automatically before the final battle after his brother Alwe convinces him to defect to the Alliance.

name: Lilwn
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the story mission 'The Revenant Army Returns' in Yarnaan.

name: Jorhan
howToRecruit: Speak to him outside Hishahn Trading Post; appraise Unknown Antiques gathered from Desert Scarabs until you obtain a Yellow Rose Censer.

name: Falward
howToRecruit: Speak to him inside the clinic in northwest Altverden during or after 'Reveal Harlan's Schemes' and deliver 15 Healing Herbs.

name: Nil
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the journey to Norristar after visiting the forest Rune Barrow with Nowa, Marisa, and Garoo.

name: Chandra
howToRecruit: Inspect the Drill Ground at HQ with Code L to hear rumors of a dragon, then travel to Eldroad and defeat Chandra in combat.

name: Aleior
howToRecruit: MISSABLE: Speak to Marisa at HQ during 'To Norristar, the Western Nation' to hear about a griffin, then find and defeat Aleior in the Abandoned Mine before Marisa departs for Castle Harganthia.

name: Dijkstra
howToRecruit: Speak to him on the west pier in Twinhorne East after the Athrabalt Front, and complete his treacherous escort quest through the Chelonian Ruins.

name: Alwe
howToRecruit: Joins automatically as the elven representative during the Alliance journey to Norristar.

name: Pohl
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Seign Kesling following the battle at Hishahn Front.

name: Francesca
howToRecruit: Walk up the left stairs in Altverden Village during 'The Watch Captain's First Job' to trigger a cutscene defending her.

name: Momo
howToRecruit: Speak to Momo by the Hishahn armor shop bridge, enter the Seaside Cavern to defeat the kraken boss, and invite Momo to HQ.

name: El Alicanto
howToRecruit: Return to Snowpeak Pass after completing its story events, travel up the hidden north trail, and defeat El Alicanto in a duel.

name: Gieran
howToRecruit: Find him at a campfire on the spiral river island in Greatwood East; deliver a Rune of Conversion (dropped by Treefolk in Greatwood).

name: Mihlu
howToRecruit: Joins automatically at Castle HQ after completing both 'Shi'arcs of a Scale' and 'The Rune-Lens Research Laboratory'.

name: Milana
howToRecruit: Upgrade the Castle Rune Shop via Drafting Studio to unlock Runeshards, then enter the shop to trigger her recruitment scene.

name: Sabine
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the early story conference with Lady Perrielle after the burning of Kyshiri Village.

name: Kallathor
howToRecruit: Joins automatically after helping the Treefolk cleanse the Dendriarch in the Greatwood and clearing the Proving Grounds.

name: Rudy
howToRecruit: When Rudy interrupts the summit in Athrabalt seeking help for trapped village children, accompany him through the Ice Cave and defeat the boss.

name: CJ
howToRecruit: Place Garoo and Isha in your active party, head to the HQ south exit during 'To Norristar', and help CJ clear the Southern Runebarrows.

name: Isha
howToRecruit: Speak to her near the fountain in southeast Eltisweiss; locate a lost black cat in town, purchase Cat's Eye jewels, and bring them back.

name: Garoo
howToRecruit: Playable earlier in the campaign, but officially joins the Alliance roster alongside Marisa during the journey to Norristar.

name: Chron
howToRecruit: Speak to him standing on the road near the south gate of Castle Town after returning from the Proving Grounds to build the castle gate.

name: Sumire
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the retreat from Eltisweiss to operate castle item storage.

name: Caine
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' to establish fast-travel appraisal and town development.

name: Hiro
howToRecruit: Encounter him in the eastern cavern of the Abandoned Mine mid-point; assist him in clearing cave-in rubble to establish his medicine shop.

name: Allaby
howToRecruit: Speak to her beside the counter in the Castle Town Inn during or after 'An Unexpected Ally' to recruit her directly.

name: Galladur
howToRecruit: Travel to the depths of the Proving Grounds after clearing Snowpeak Pass, and defeat 3 waves of subterranean trials.

name: Cabana
howToRecruit: Speak to Cabana and Pyba beside the Inn in Impershi'arc, and invite him to establish a hot spring bath at Castle HQ.

name: Martha
howToRecruit: Speak to her on the eastern grounds of Castle Town during 'Hoist the Alliance Banner' to unlock pasture farming.

name: Scarlet
howToRecruit: Speak to her at the sandcraft dock in Impershi'arc and defeat her record time in a head-to-head sandcraft race.

name: Mandie
howToRecruit: Joins automatically immediately after recruiting Paquia in Arenside to serve as race commentator for the eggfoot track.

name: Celia
howToRecruit: Complete 15 cooking duel battles against rival chefs hosted by Kurtz at HQ restaurant; Celia joins automatically after the 15th battle.

name: Reid
howToRecruit: Progress through Dr. Corque's Beigoma questline, collect high-tier tops, defeat all regional spinning top masters, and beat Reid in battle.

name: Shixeen
howToRecruit: Build the Card Shop with Glen, upgrade it to Level 3, collect at least 120 unique cards, and defeat Shixeen in a card match.

name: Euma
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the summit of allied rulers at Athrabalt.

name: Kassius
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Euma during the summit of allied rulers at Athrabalt.

name: Janquis
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Lady Perrielle during the main story campaign in Euchrisse.

name: Elektra
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.

name: Vorrdice
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.

name: Viesskin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall following the defense of the fortress against the imperial forces.

name: Kogen
howToRecruit: Joins automatically with his bandit crew following the battle and retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Yuthus
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Kogen following the battle and retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Zabi
howToRecruit: Joins automatically alongside Kogen and Yuthus following the retreat from Eltisweiss.

name: Yulin
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the climax of the Athrabalt Front when she arrives with the Shi'arc fleet.

name: Skyd
howToRecruit: Joins automatically following the sandcraft race competition during 'Shi'arcs of a Scale'.

name: Pastole
howToRecruit: Speak to him beside his blue and teal canopy stall next to the Tool Shop in Twinhorne East to recruit him directly.

name: Galdorf
howToRecruit: Speak to him at the Abandoned Mine entrance during or after 'Reveal Harlan's Schemes'; bring him Palenight Mail armor (found in mine chest or crafted).

name: Prunella
howToRecruit: Speak to her inside the Dabavin Inn during or after 'New Forces' and pay her fee of 100,000 Baqua (she refunds 50,000 immediately).

name: Fume
howToRecruit: Recruit Enoe and establish the Mission Guild first, then speak to Fume in the northeast section of Dappled Forest.

name: Enoe
howToRecruit: Build the Mission Guild via Drafting Studio, then speak to Enoe in Daphan Village to recruit him.

name: Dalton
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3, build the Mission Guild, place Sabine in your party, and speak to Dalton outside the Twinhorne East Inn.

name: Durlan
howToRecruit: Upgrade HQ to Level 3; enter the Abandoned Mine from the castle basement well and navigate to the deepest western rock wall to find him chiseling.

name: Larla
howToRecruit: Recruit Enoe and Fume, dispatch guild mission squads until achieving an 'Epic Success', then speak to Larla at the counter in Eltisweiss Inn.

name: Leene
howToRecruit: MISSABLE: You must recruit all other 119 base-game characters before initiating the war battle at Castle Harganthia. Leene then appears in Castle HQ before the final assault.

name: Grace
howToRecruit: Joins automatically during the story chapters of the Seign DLC expansion (requires recapturing Eltisweiss in the main storyline).

name: Goldwyn
howToRecruit: Joins automatically in the Great Hall after repelling the Imperial invasion before the Final Battle.
